citations.assessment: Avot 1:8 names Yehudah and Shimon as recipients from the preceding pair and gives Yehudah’s judicial advice.
Mishnah and Bavli list Yehudah and Shimon on opposite sides of the laying-on-of-hands debate. Both name the pairs and identify heads without an unambiguous resolution of the attribution dispute.
Heilprin invokes an editorial principle about anonymous Mishnah. Avot names the pair without explicit office labels, while Mishnah Chagigah has a general sequence. The office inference remains his.
Bavli gives Meir and the sages’ opposing attributions. Yerushalmi explicitly preserves alternating teachings on the nasi.
